verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Zapier's help article on troubleshooting errors in Zap workflows. It covers identifying common errors and AI-generated troubleshooting instructions, so failed runs are surfaced and diagnosable. Nothing in the pack shows user-defined error-handling paths, dedicated error workflows, or alerts when a run fails. Missing for 10: documented error-handler paths or error workflows, failure notifications or alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
